name: TableBatchActions

props.name: shouldShowBatchActions
props.description: Boolean specifier for whether or not the batch action bar should be displayed.

props.name: totalCount
props.description: Numeric representation of the total number of items in a table. This number is used in the select all button text

props.name: totalSelected
props.description: Numeric representation of the total number of items selected in a table. This number is used to derive the selection message.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon TableBatchActions rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
